description: Get one attachment of a remote note — a file, not text. Canonical loop: federated_note_html(kb_id, path) -> for each name in its assets: federated_asset(kb_id, note_path=<that path>, name=<name>). Returns the asset's size and sha256 and a short-lived download URL on this server that streams the file from the remote base; fetch it with curl (the URL needs no other credential) and check the sha256. The file itself never comes back in the tool result. Only a directly connected base: kb_id without '/'.

kb_id.description: Directly connected knowledge base id, as in federated_note_html

name.description: One name from that note's assets, copied verbatim, e.g. "files/attach.zip"

note_path.description: The remote note's path, exactly as passed to federated_note_html

name: federated_asset
